name: Dead-tooth Jack
summary: In eastern Elwynn Forest, retired Marshal Haggard needs your help: Dead-tooth Jack tricked him into giving up his badge. Jack wore a Stormwind tabard and pretended to be Marshal Dughan. Haggard fears the Defias Brotherhood will use the badge to impersonate Stormwind officials.

sections.title: A Con in the Dark
sections.body: At night, a figure wearing a Stormwind tabard came to Haggard's isolated cottage on Elwynn's eastern ridges. The stranger claimed to have official business and asked for Haggard's old marshal's badge. Haggard believed he was handing it to a fellow officer, so he gave it over. The figure laughed and vanished into the woods. He was a Defias rogue called Dead-tooth Jack.

sections.title: The Threat of False Authority
sections.body: Marshal Haggard has retired, but his badge still carries Stormwind's legal authority. Defias bandits are creeping across Elwynn, Westfall, and Redridge. With the badge, they could pass guard checkpoints, redirect patrols, or take command of supplies. Jack retreated to a camp to the south and locked the badge in a strongbox. Haggard needs it back before the Defias cause serious harm.

faq.answer: Dead-tooth Jack is a Defias operative in eastern Elwynn Forest. At night, he posed as Marshal Dughan and tricked retired Marshal Haggard into handing over his official Stormwind badge.

faq.q: Why does Marshal Haggard need his badge back?
faq.answer: Marshal Haggard needs his badge back because it is an authentic sign of Stormwind authority. He fears the Defias will use it to impersonate officials, bypass military patrols, and cause havoc across the realm.

faq.q: How did Jack manage to fool Marshal Haggard?
aliases: why did haggard give the badge
faq.answer: Jack came to Haggard's cottage at night wearing a Stormwind tabard. In the poor light, Haggard mistook him for Marshal Dughan of Goldshire and gave him the badge, believing he was helping a fellow officer.

faq.q: Where does Jack keep the stolen badge?
faq.answer: Jack keeps the stolen badge locked in a strongbox at his bandit camp south of Marshal Haggard's house. He carries the key on his person.

faq.q: Who sent you to Marshal Haggard in the first place?
faq.answer: Harry Burlguard, a veteran warrior who frequents the Pig and Whistle Tavern in Stormwind, sends adventurers to Marshal Haggard. He knows the retired marshal may trade spare weaponry for help.

faq.q: What happens once the badge is returned?
faq.answer: Marshal Haggard is greatly relieved that the Defias cannot use his identity or rank against the kingdom. He salutes you in thanks and offers your choice of well-maintained military weapons from his years in service.

angles.text: As a human of Stormwind, you can see how vulnerable the kingdom's rural borders are to Defias infiltrators. They wear the crown's own colors to deceive retired veterans.
Marshal Haggard was once a veteran frontline fighter. As a warrior, you can earn his thanks and choose from the spare arms he kept from his years of service.
As a rogue, you can see that Dead-tooth Jack's caper depends on disguise, deception, and impudence as much as crude highway robbery.
